events.title: Classic Albums Live: Billy Joel – The Stranger
events.description:
Classic Albums Live brings Billy Joel’s The Stranger to life on stage, note for note, cut for cut.

 

Known for recreating the world’s greatest classic rock albums with precision and respect, Classic Albums Live focuses entirely on the music, with no costumes or impersonations.

 

The first half of the show features a faithful performance of The Stranger, the landmark album that includes unforgettable songs like “Movin’ Out,” “Just the Way You Are,” “Only the Good Die Young,” “She’s Always a Woman,” and “Scenes from an Italian Restaurant.” beloved records.

events.title: Miracle on 34th Street
events.description:
Miracle on 34th Street is a heartwarming holiday classic about the kind and cheerful Kris Kringle, hired to play Santa Claus at a New York City department store. When Kris insists that he truly is Santa, his claim is met with skepticism, especially by Doris Walker, a practical single mother, and her doubting daughter Susan. When Kris’ identity and sanity are called into question, the question becomes bigger than whether he is really Santa: Can people still find room for faith, hope, and goodwill in our commonsense world.

A cherished classic for over 75 years, Miracle on 34th Street is a heartwarming story about believing in the impossible, the power of kindness, and the magic of Christmas.

Santa Claus is coming to town, but this year he’s here to prove it! Do you Believe?

Performances are November 26-27 at 7:30pm and November 28-29 at 2:00pm

Doors open 20 minutes before each performance. Theatre Wellesley uses general seating, so seating is first come, first choice.

Pictures with Santa will be available in the lobby before each show (watch our social media for times).

events.title: Christkindl Market
events.description:
Willkommen to the 30th anniversary of Christkindl, celebrating three decades of holiday tradition by expanding the festivities to 10 magical days. Come for all your favourite sights, sounds and smells of a classic European market, and stay for the tasty treats, live entertainment, and warm holiday ambience.

  • 90+ local vendors selling one-of-a-kind holiday gifts from December 3-6 and 10-13
  • Timing varies by day – please see website for full schedule
  • 10 days of live entertainment
  • Family-friendly KidsKindl zone both weekends
  • Outdoor food market and licensed area
  • Maple taffy, blacksmith, ice sculpture contest, outdoor skating and more

Whether you’re visiting for a day of holiday shopping, an evening performance, an afternoon of family-friendly activities, or are excited to experience everything Christkindl has in store, there are more opportunities than ever to experience the magic of the season.

Dates and times

  • December 3 – 4 to 9 p.m.
  • December 4 – 10 a.m. to 9 p.m.

events.title: Yuk Yuk’s 50th Anniversary Spectacular
events.description:
Celebrate 50 years of fearless, unfiltered comedy when the Yuk Yuk’s 50th Anniversary Tour takes over Centre In The Square on Saturday, November 21!

Since its establishment in 1976, Yuk Yuk’s has become the backbone of Canadian stand-up comedy. For five decades, this homegrown institution has helped shape Canada’s distinctive comedic voice and set the standard for live, uncensored laughs from coast to coast.

More than a comedy club, Yuk Yuk’s has launched the careers of global entertainment icons including Jim Carrey, Norm Macdonald, Russell Peters, Howie Mandel, and many more. Now, this milestone anniversary tour celebrates that legendary legacy while showcasing a powerhouse lineup of today’s rising comedy stars.

Expect an electric night of brilliant storytelling, rapid-fire wit, and fearless humour from some of Canada’s sharpest modern comedians.

Don’t miss your chance to celebrate five decades of Canadian comedy and witness the next generation of comedy history live in Kitchener.

events.title: Dirty Drag Bingo- Hosted by Crystal Quartz

events.title: There’s No Place Like Space – Kids Event
events.description:
There’s No Place Like Space!
A little space adventure for curious little minds, ages 6 months–6 years.
Ready to explore a universe of colours, textures, rainbows, and fizzy surprises?

Join Smartizen for a one-hour, space-themed adventure designed especially

for babies, toddlers, preschoolers upto 6yo. Through sensory play, creative crafts, and playful science experiments, little explorers can discover new things at their own pace while enjoying a special experience with their family.

What will your little explorer discover?
Explore the Solar System and Moon Phases — Explore a space-inspired sensory world filled with colours, textures, and opportunities for imaginative play.
Make Your Own Spaceship Cards — Create a spaceship card together and take home.
The Walking Rainbow — Watch colours travel and blend in a fascinating experiment that introduces little ones to the joy of observation and discovery.
Into the Fizzy Universe! — Discover bubbly, colourful reactions in a playful introduction to science.
and of course music and books about the Outer Space!
A family adventure, not just a kids’ activity
At Smartizen, we believe childhood isn’t something to rush. Young children learn by touching, watching, listening, exploring, and trying things out. This experience gives you the chance to enjoy those little moments of discovery together.

Both parents are welcome! Each session is designed for a small group of just five families, allowing families to enjoy the activities in a more intimate setting.
